text:
jordan: heads up — customers reporting big p99 regressions on streaming generation after we flipped the new tokenization path for the orion-2b-lf rollout yesterday. p95 for >6k token inputs also climbed. anyone on call?

priya: saw the alerts at 22:20 UTC, routed some traffic to fallback models but a few sessions still hung during streaming. adding logs and a minimal repro below. tagging @lee who owns model onboarding. :warning:

deploy-bot: deployed orion-2b-lf (variant: bpe-v3) to us-west-prod at 2026-03-16T22:12:07Z by ci/cd.

jordan: repro steps (minimal):
```
# reproduce streaming latency: long prompt ~7k tokens
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"orion-2b-lf","input":"<7k-token-prompt>","stream":true}'
```
Observed behaviour: streaming begins but inter-token delay jumps to ~120-180ms mid-stream (expected ~10-30ms). p99 jumps on requests with early multibyte tokens (CJK-heavy).

priya: snippet from proxy logs (token delays):
```
[stream-req 2026-03-16T22:23:49Z] token_delta_ms=12
[stream-req 2026-03-16T22:23:49Z] token_delta_ms=15
[stream-req 2026-03-16T22:23:49Z] token_delta_ms=165  # stall starts here
[stream-req 2026-03-16T22:23:50Z] token_delta_ms=142
```

lee: thanks — initial bench shows bpe-v3 (the new tokenizer variant) adds a blocking normalization pass that is O(n) with a large constant for multi-byte scripts. on long contexts this runs per request during pre-tokenization and occasionally at streaming checkpoints which stalls the runtime. reproducer attached.

lee: quick test: switched model artifact locally to bpe-v2 and reran same prompt. streaming latencies returned to baseline. suspecting pre-tokenization cost and also subtle interaction with kv-cache warm/cold boundary.

ops: created internal incident INC-2026-0031 and set priority P1 for impact on customers. Support ticket TKT-90821 opened. support-bot assigned.

priya: mitigation #1: traffic shifted to fallback route (orion-2b-slim) for affected customers. mitigation #2: temporarily rolled tokenizer for orion-2b-lf back to bpe-v2 in prod to restore streaming behavior. Rolled at 22:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout: orion-2b-lf tokenizer set to bpe-v2 in us-west-prod at 2026-03-16T22:45:12Z by ops/quick-rollback.

jordan: after rollback p99 dropped close to baseline for samples we watched. still need root cause + fix for bpe-v3 perf regression.

lee: proposed next steps:
- add microbench for pre-tokenization cost across scripts (Latin/CJK/emoji) and integrate into our onboarding checks.
- modify tokenization pipeline so heavy normalization runs asynchronously or cached per-request prefix where safe.
- add early KV-cache-warm probe to streaming path to avoid checkpointing stalls.
- add unit/regression test that asserts streaming inter-token < 50ms for long contexts.

priya: temporary customer-facing mitigation: communicated rollback + asked for any failing prompts/examples. ops to keep fallback route for 24 hours then re-evaluate. :white_check_mark:

ops: monitoring dashboards updated, alert thresholds tightened for streaming inter-token > 50ms. will keep an eye for related model rollouts.

lee: extracting patch work: (1) optimize normalization algorithm (target 3x faster for CJK), (2) add caching by prefix hash, (3) add preflight tokenization sampling on deploy to catch regressions. aiming for PRs today and bench in staging.

jordan: thanks team. please dump any failing prompts into the ticket. support will follow up with impacted customers.

support-bot: TKT-90821 updated: rollback completed, customers notified, monitoring active.

priya: marking this thread for postmortem after 48h. assigning to @lee for root-cause and remediation plan. :memo:

lee: I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups. starting with perf benchmark and a small canary with synthetic CJK-heavy prompts.

jordan: closing the escalation for now — reopen if p99 resurfaces. :handshake:
